description: React component for viewing server logs with date filtering, using various UI components and APIs.

classes.name: DatePickerCustomInput
classes.description: Custom input component for date picker with styled button.

methods.name: getDateBefore
methods.description: Calculates a date before the current date based on units (hours, days, months) and value.

methods.name: getDateTimeFormatted
methods.description: Formats a date object into a string 'YYYY-MM-DD-HH'.

methods.name: subtractTime
methods.description: Subtracts specified months, days, and hours from current date and returns formatted string.

methods.name: handleTimeSelectionChange
methods.description: Handles change in selected time range and triggers log API request accordingly.

methods.name: onStartDateSelected
methods.description: Updates start date and fetches logs for the selected date range.

methods.name: onEndDateSelected
methods.description: Updates end date and fetches logs for the selected date range.
